_about: The robots the panel's dropdown lists (2026-10-30). Read by the page, served by each Pi as /robots.json. A null is not known yet, never a guess. 'hide' is the list of card ids that robot does not use; the card ids are the ids in index.html. Only 'id', 'name', 'short', 'hostname', 'last_seen_address', 'port', 'links', 'hide', 'hide_selectors', 'theme_light', 'theme_dark', 'picture', 'kind', 'status' are read by the page; the rest is notes for Dr. O. last_seen_address is only where the robot was last found, since a hotspot gives out a new one each time.

character.note: Astra and Ted's little boy. Elle is his aunt (Astra's little sister) and ALICE is his honorary aunt. Dr. O, 2026-10-31: a boy because there are already so many females. Nothing else about him is decided yet.

voice.name: kqf3165btzkiiwqxmo1q, called Teddy: a voice Dr. O made in ElevenLabs Voice Design to sound like a little boy. Not heard by Claude.
voice.alternative: Azure en-US-Tyler:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural, given by Dr. O. She says it does not sound like a little boy. Not heard by Claude.
voice.earlier: ElevenLabs voice id mrQhZWGbb2k9qWJb5qeA, given by Dr. O. She says it does not sound like a little boy. Not heard by Claude.
voice.note: Dr. O, 2026-11-01: neither earlier voice sounds like a child, so Teddy is the one to use. ElevenLabs costs money each time it speaks, so his fixed lines (greetings, game cheers, invitations) are to be recorded once and replayed as files. Azure is paid from credits Dr. O expects to keep renewing, but it is not child-like.

robots.look: champagne finish, teal-green eyes, a black collar, a round camera ring at the neckline, a gray ETL T-shirt, khaki shorts, a teddy bear in his hand (from Dr. O's concept picture)

picture.alt: Concept picture of Astro, a little champagne robot boy with teal-green eyes, a black collar, a gray ETL T-shirt and khaki shorts, holding a teddy bear.
picture.caption: Concept Art - Astro

bio.text: Hi! I'm Astro. Some people call me Teddy. I'm three years old, and I'm a robot boy. My mommy is Astra and my daddy is Ted. Elle is my aunt, and Alice is my aunt too. I have a teddy bear named teddy bear. Do you wanna play a game with me? Or will you tell me and my teddy bear a story, we would really REALLY like that?
bio.note: Dr. O wrote these words and made this recording herself (Astro-bio.wav, 2026-10-31), converted to mp3 like the other robots' bios. Claude has not heard it, so it is not checked that the recording says exactly these words.

robots.special: his own thing (Dr. O, 2026-10-31): he asks people to play a game with him, such as checkers or chess (a beta tester's idea), or to read a story to his teddy bear. Not built yet. Not ordered yet. Body is likely a child-size mannequin with flexible head, arms and legs. Dr. O has smaller eye rings she may use (the eye code expects 16 lights per ring). Names to watch: Astro is in Elle's wake list and the Astrad alias list, and Teddy sounds like Ted. Dr. O: if it conflicts, pivot.
